messages.subject: packrat / .Rprofile issue when deploying to shiny app
parts:
I stystematically get an error when deploying to shinyapps.io:

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading bundle for application: 54984...DONE
Deploying bundle: 239375 for application: 54984 ...
Waiting for task: 66666044
  building: Parsing manifest
  building: Building image: 234690
  building: Building package: git2r
################################ Begin Task Log ################################ 
[2015-08-14T05:08:48.954219239+0000] Installing R package: whisker (0.3-2)
Error in file(filename, "r", encoding = encoding) : 
  cannot open the connection
Calls: source -> file
In addition: Warning message:
In file(filename, "r", encoding = encoding) :
  cannot open file 'packrat/init.R': No such file or directory
Execution halted
################################# End Task Log ################################# 
Erreur : Unhandled Exception: Child Task 66666046 failed: Error building image: Error building git2r (0.11.0). Build exited with non-zero status: 1

but my D:\datasciencecoursera\DSCapstoneShinyApp\.Rprofile contains:
#### -- Packrat Autoloader (version 0.4.4) -- ####
source("packrat/init.R")
#### -- End Packrat Autoloader -- ####

I tried to stop using packrat in my project, deleting all packrat subdirs and use it again, without any result.

Has anyone any idea ?
Thanks for your help.

messages.author: 850e813b15fcf9e1
messages.subject: Re: packrat / .Rprofile issue when deploying to shiny app
parts:
UPDATE : 
- I copied the `packrat/init.R` in my working directory and the deployment was successful.
- When I delete this file from my working directory (and let the legitimate existing one in packrat subdir) I can reproduce this error.
- I first used the Publishing button in RStudio (Version 0.99.467). So I got the error as presented above,in RStudio Deploy tab.  
- When I use the R command (with rsconnect package loaded)
deployApp(getwd(), appName = "DSCapstoneShinyApp")
I get the same error, but in the shinyapp webpage once deployed. The R Console shows a successful deployment.
Of course I have done the correct setup of Publishing in Global Options in RStudio.
By the way the details of my connection are well known of RStudio as I didn't need to specify them in the above command.
